2609.30079.title: Reachability-Based Formal Verification of Graph Neural Networks with Node and Edge Features
2609.30079.paper_summary: Graph neural networks (GNNs) have become a prominent approach for developing fast, topology-aware surrogates in electric power systems, supporting tasks such as power flow (PF) analysis, optimal power flow (OPF) estimation, and cascading failure analysis (CFA). Despite this growing use, formally verifying GNN-based models remains challenging, with existing methods limited in scope. We extend the neural network verification (NNV) framework to graph-structured inputs through GraphStar sets, a generalization of Star sets that captures uncertainty over both node and edge features. This extension enables the propagation of linear message-passing operations and the sound approximation of ReLU nonlinearities for GNN architectures, including graph convolutional network (GCN) and graph isomorphism network with edge features (GINE) layers. We evaluate GNNV across three power system tasks, PF, OPF, and CFA, on the IEEE-24, IEEE-39, and IEEE-118 test cases, as well as two standard graph classification benchmarks, ENZYMES and PROTEINS. Our results show that GNNV provides tighter robustness guarantees than CORA on graph classification models with ReLU-based activations and, for the first time, delivers edge-aware robustness guarantees for GINE-based PF and OPF models under joint node and edge perturbations.
2609.30079.paper_summary_zh: 圖神經網絡（GNNs）已成為電力系統中開發快速、拓撲感知替代模型的主要方法，支持如功率流（PF）分析、最佳功率流（OPF）估計和級聯故障分析（CFA）等任務。儘管這種使用日益增長，但正式驗證基於GNN的模型仍然具有挑戰性，現有方法的範圍有限。我們通過GraphStar集擴展了神經網絡驗證（NNV）框架，以適應圖結構輸入，GraphStar集是Star集的一種概括，捕捉了節點和邊特徵上的不確定性。這一擴展使得線性消息傳遞操作的傳播成為可能，並對GNN架構中的ReLU非線性進行了合理的近似，包括圖卷積網絡（GCN）和具有邊特徵的圖同構網絡（GINE）層。我們在IEEE-24、IEEE-39和IEEE-118測試案例上，以及兩個標準圖分類基準ENZYMES和PROTEINS上，對GNNV在三個電力系統任務PF、OPF和CFA進行了評估。我們的結果顯示，GNNV在具有ReLU激活的圖分類模型上提供了比CORA更緊的穩健性保證，並且首次為GINE基於PF和OPF模型在聯合節點和邊擾動下提供了邊感知的穩健性保證。
